## Signing

You sign this Agreement electronically by posting the following comment on
your pull request when prompted by the CLA bot:

> I have read the CLA Document and I hereby sign the CLA

Your GitHub username, account id, and the timestamp of your signature are
recorded in the project's signature store. One signature covers all your
subsequent contributions. Questions before signing? Open a discussion or
email [licensing@cerulion.com](mailto:licensing@cerulion.com).
